content: Pardon me, officer. I want to go to Bums Park. Would you please tell me how to get there?
Yes, Miss. Bums Park is about half a mile from here. Do you want to take a bus or walk? The bus stop is on the other side of the street if you want to take a bus.
Well, I'd like to walk if it's within walking distance.
All right. We are now on Main Street. Go this way along, until you come to First Street.
Go straight along Main Street as far as First Street. Turn left onto First Street and walk another two blocks. Then you'll come to Lincoln Street?
Yes, then turn right. Walk for a few minutes. Bums park begins at the comer of Lincoln and Fifth.
